# AEA Technology, Inc. - RF and Cable Testing Equipment

## Company Overview
AEA Technology is a leading manufacturer of professional RF and cable testing equipment, including Time Domain Reflectometers (TDRs), Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs), and SWR meters. Founded in 1990, all products are designed and manufactured in the USA in Carlsbad, California.

## Key Products & Applications
- Aviation cable testing equipment
- Broadcast transmission line testing
- CATV network analysis
- Medical RF environment testing (MRI facilities)
- Telecommunications cable fault location
- RF testing and analysis
- SWR (Standing Wave Ratio) measurement
